description: This file implements functions related to emitting diff records and hunks for a diff library, including processing change hunks, generating diff output, and handling function context for diffs.

classes.name: struct func_line
classes.description: Structure used for holding function line information such as length and buffer.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_record(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri,char const * pre,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emit a diff record for a specific line in the file structure.

methods.name: long saturating_add(long a,long b)
methods.description: Add two longs with saturation at LONG_MAX to prevent overflow.

methods.name: xdchange_t * xdl_get_hunk(xdchange_t ** xscr,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Determine the range of a diff hunk based on configuration and change atoms.

methods.name: long def_ff(const char * rec,long len,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Default function to extract a function name from a record if no custom find_func is provided.

methods.name: long match_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Match a record against the function name pattern, using custom find_func if provided.

methods.name: int is_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri)
methods.description: Check whether a record is a function record based on matching function pattern.

methods.name: long get_func_line(xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)
methods.description: Retrieve a function name line from a file starting at a specified line.

methods.name: int is_empty_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri)
methods.description: Check whether a record (line) in the file is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diff(xdfenv_t * xe,xdchange_t * xscr,xdemitcb_t * ecb,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Main function to emit a diff between two files, processing change hunks and outputting diff lines.
